# Holiday return extension 2025

## Extended window for gifts

Gifts purchased between November 15 and December 31, 2025 may be returned, opened or unopened, until January 31, 2026.

# Return policy

Version 1. Applies to orders placed from January 1, 2025 through March 31, 2026.

## Return window

Products may be returned within 30 days of delivery. Start a return from the order

turn from the order page.

## Opened products

Opened products may be returned within 30 days of delivery, less a 15% restocking fee. Defective products are exempt from the fee.

# Return policy

Version 2. Applies to orders placed on or after April 1, 2026.

## Refunds

Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of the return being received.

# Shipping and delivery

## Delivery times

Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days where available.

## Damaged packages

ckage arrives damaged, keep the packaging and report it within 48 hours so that a carrier claim can be opened.

# Manufacturer warranty

## Coverage

Most products carry a 12-month manufacturer warranty from the date of purchase. Warranty service for a defective product is repair or replacement by the manufactu

ent by the manufacturer.

## Making a claim

Contact the manufacturer with the serial number and proof of purchase. Support can look up the manufacturer contact for any order.
